summary: Audited src/relay.rs (1-659), security-first. Crypto core sound: client-proves-first X25519 handshake, direction-separated keys, proofs bound to both pubkeys, was_contributory checks, fail-closed strict-seq AES-256-GCM, constant-time proof compare, secrets never logged. 2 Low findings in session-slot bookkeeping; u64 seq wraparound is theoretical only.

files.description: Audit target: E2E crypto (47-263), run_tunnel reconnect loop (270-318), tunnel_once session lifecycle (333-525), client_connect (533-632), urlencoding (638-650), RelayState (655-659). Full file read.

architecture: run_tunnel (infinite reconnect loop, 5s/60s backoff, per-attempt SecretRef resolution) -> tunnel_once: dial /register, first frame {"auth":secret}, select loop over relay frames / outbound writer / done-channel. Each new client id spawns a session task: daemon_handshake under HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT=15s, then decrypt+encrypt pumps bridging to rpc::handle_socket. Slots: HashMap<u64,(Sender,AbortHandle)>, MAX_SESSIONS=32, freed by relay disconnect, backpressure abort, and done_tx. Crypto: X25519 ephemeral DH, proof=sha256(token||mine||theirs), keys sha256(shared||d2c/c2d), seq-as-nonce, seq==expected enforced (replay/reorder fail closed).
report:
FINDINGS

[Low] Session slot leak: task spawned before map insert (src/relay.rs:495-506, done handler 515-521)
Evidence: `tokio::spawn(session task); sessions.insert(client_id, (in_tx, task.abort_handle())); tokio::spawn(async move { let _ = task.await; let _ = done_tx.send(client_id).await; });` and done branch `if let Some(client_id) = done { sessions.remove(&client_id); }`
Scenario: if the task exits before insert (auth_token unavailable/Err -> immediate return; or in_rx instantly closed), the done notification can be processed before sessions.insert. remove() is a no-op, then insert stores a dead entry no future notification will free. If the relay never sends disconnect, the slot leaks; repeats exhaust MAX_SESSIONS=32 until tunnel reconnect.
Fix: carry the AbortHandle in the done message and remove only when the stored handle matches.

[Low] Duplicate client_id overwrites live session without aborting old task (src/relay.rs:415-499)
Evidence: new-client branch `} else if v.get("data").is_none() {` fires for any frame with a client u64 and no data key (including {"client":N,"disconnect":false}); insert at 499 overwrites without aborting the stored AbortHandle.
Scenario: second connect notification for the same id (buggy/hostile relay) overwrites the old entry; old task later exits and its done notification removes the NEW live session's entry — live session becomes invisible to disconnect/backpressure cleanup and the count can exceed MAX_SESSIONS.
Fix: on insert, abort pre-existing handle or refuse duplicate id.

VERIFIED CLEAN (dedup material for next audit): client-proves-first ordering prevents unauthenticated (pubkey,proof) harvesting (92-127); proof sha256(token||mine||theirs) binds both fixed-length pubkeys (216-224); direction-separated keys with distinct labels d2c/c2d (141-148, 226-232) block reflection; was_contributory checked both sides (124-125, 163-164); decrypt requires seq==expected, increments only after MAC success, any error closes session fail-closed (196-214); getrandom_rng all-OS-RNG (241-263); run_tunnel backoff 5s/60s, secret re-resolved per attempt, unresolvable secret refuses registration loudly (283-318); ws:// warning correct incl. [::1], [5..] slice safe (272-280); auth frame never in URL query (340-349); 4MiB frame caps both sides (343-346, 543-546); HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT both sides; client failure aborts read_pump (no lingering relay slot); try_send backpressure isolation (400-413); urlencoding byte-wise RFC3986 unreserved-only, UTF-8-safe (638-650); secrets never logged.

NOTES: u64 seq wraparound (encrypt:180) would reuse a nonce but needs 2^64 frames — theoretical, not filed. AAD absence verified non-exploitable (direction keys + fresh DH + strict seq cover swap/replay). decrypt load/store not atomic but single decrypt pump per session — no current race. Relay-observed-proof token brute is a documented design constraint (file header 14-17). Out of scope: bins/damon-relay.rs (BinRelaySrv), npm/client.mjs (NpmAudit).
